propositions: Provider construction logic is currently inline in runner.py:268 as a special case for Anthropic, requiring new branches for each additional provider (Bedrock, OpenAI-compatible) instead of a single registration point

httpx.AsyncClient lifecycle (created during provider construction, closed in runner.py:446-452) cannot be attached to pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook return type and requires a session object to own teardown

ProviderSession must be constructed once per run() call, hold a builder registry mapping provider names to callables, expose a provider_factory matching pydantic-ai's hook signature (str)->Provider, and track closeables for deterministic cleanup

Anthropic provider construction will move into a dedicated builder maintaining existing behavior (tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, loopback-proxy bypass, per-request httpx.Timeout), and _build_retrying_anthropic_model imports must update from rebar.llm.runner to rebar.llm.anthropic_model
Unknown provider names must raise LLMConfigError listing registered providers, and model_override path must bypass the factory and construct no client resources
Session must close all registered client resources both on normal run() return and on exception, verified against real client object closed state
